newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toshiba-IBM, NEC-Samsung tie-ups set on DRAM - paper.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba-IBM, NEC-Samsung tie-ups set on DRAM - paper.

text.p: Toshiba Corp and NEC Corp have separately decided to cooperate with foreign partners in developing facilities to produce next-generation 256 megabit dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) chips, a Japanese business daily said on Friday.
Toshiba has agreed with International Business Machines Corp of the United States to exchange information on equipment to produce 300 mm wafers, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
They may jointly set up wafer production facilities, it said.
NEC plans to tie up with Samsung Electronics Co Ltd of South Korea on the design and development of production facilities, the paper said.
The two Japanese firms have already tied up with their respective foreign partners in various research efforts on new technologies, the paper said.
Toshiba could not immediately confirm the report and NEC spokesmen were not immediately available for comment.
